name: CSV Cleaner and Deduper
title: CSV Cleaner: Remove Duplicates, Blank Rows and Extra Spaces
description: Clean a CSV in your browser: trim spaces, drop empty rows, remove duplicates by any column (case-insensitive), tidy headers, and download the result. Nothing is uploaded.
card: Trim, dedupe and drop blank rows from a CSV without uploading it.
lede: Open or paste a CSV, choose a column to dedupe on (email is picked automatically), and download a clean file ready for import.
answer_q: How do I remove duplicates from a CSV file?
answer: Pick the column that identifies a record, usually email, and keep only the first row for each value, ignoring case and extra spaces. Open your file here, choose that column, and download the cleaned CSV.
steps: Paste the CSV or open the file. The delimiter is detected automatically.
Choose the column to dedupe on, or Whole row.
Keep trim, empty row removal and case-insensitive matching on.
Check the counts and the preview table.
Download the clean CSV. It opens in Excel with accents intact.

faq.q: Is there a file size limit?
faq.a: Only your device's memory. Files with tens of thousands of rows are fine on a normal laptop.
The first one in the file. Sort the file first if you want to keep, for example, the most recent record.

faq.q: Does it change my original file?
faq.a: No. You get a new download. The original file on your computer is not touched.

faq.q: Why do accents look wrong when I open the result in Excel?
faq.a: The download includes a byte order mark so Excel reads it as UTF-8. If you copy and paste instead, use Excel's Data, From Text/CSV import and pick UTF-8.
